Config query helpers and leftover-pod warning logic.

# Purpose
This header defines helper functions for reading values from a `fd_pod_t` configuration object and converting them into C types. It also declares [`fdctl_pod_find_leftover`](<#fdctl_pod_find_leftover>), which walks a pod tree and logs a warning for any unused leaf item, so the caller can detect unrecognized configuration options after loading a file. The inline `fdctl_cfg_get_*` functions validate the stored value type, convert the value to `char *`, `ulong`, `uint`, `ushort`, `int`, or `float`, and log a warning when the value type or range is invalid.
# Function Declarations (Public API)
